tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything; the panel's app background and the website's base.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the sidebar and table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, hovered rows and inputs inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Log viewers, code blocks and terminal-style wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table rules, card edges. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons); 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units and metadata on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: oxide
tokens.usage: The brand colour (iron oxide). Primary buttons, active nav, selected states, the mark. As text, on ground, surface and oxide-soft.

tokens.name: oxide-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of oxide controls.

tokens.name: on-oxide
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an oxide fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: oxide-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind oxide text: selected nav row, brand callouts.

tokens.name: oxide-deep
tokens.usage: Haematite. Website hero slabs and the cover; large brand fields only, never UI chrome.

tokens.name: on-oxide-deep
tokens.usage: Text on an oxide-deep field.

tokens.name: oxide-bright
tokens.usage: Fe dots, glows and accents drawn ON an oxide-deep field, in both themes (the light theme's oxide is too dark there).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Secondary identity block on the website and cover; illustration fields. Not a text colour.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Up / online / link established. Leaves the red-green axis toward teal so it never relies on hue against danger. Text on the surfaces and ok-soft; always with a word or dot label.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of ok pills and banners.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / failover active / high latency. Text on the surfaces and warn-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warn pills and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Down / error / destructive action. Crimson, deliberately pinker than oxide so it never reads as the brand. Text on the surfaces and danger-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger pills and banners.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger-filled (destructive) button.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notes, links in docs, neutral activity. Text on the surfaces and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info pills and banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 on every ground and surface, and on oxide fills via the offset gap.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in prose — an alias of info so links never look like brand buttons.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — download / RX.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — upload / TX.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — a second WAN or extra interface.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Website and empty states. Tight leading, slight negative tracking.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website hero headline only; one per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website section heads; panel first-run screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel page titles; website card headings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings inside a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Traffic moves to wan1 when wan0 misses three probes.
styles.usage: Prose, form help and website body copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, dense panel text, hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, stat captions and nav group headers. Set text-transform: uppercase.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Anything a machine produced: addresses, ports, rates, logs, config.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles (throughput, latency, clients).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IPs, MACs, interface names, ports, counters in tables.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, logs and config snippets on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls; table cell padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding-x; gap between form fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (panel); gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (website); page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter (desktop panel); gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Website block padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website section spacing.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Website hero padding.

radius.note: Small radii: hardware, not a toy.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, checkboxes, inline code, port tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, website feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and toggle tracks only.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on borders; shadows only lift floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts and dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact control height (table row actions).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height: buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Website CTAs and touch-first panel screens.
